# Witwave

> Witwave is a cloud-native autonomous agent framework for AI agent teams. It provides Kubernetes-native runtime
> infrastructure, backend routing, schedules, triggers, memory, observability, MCP tool access, and human-governed
> escalation so agents can work as durable software participants rather than isolated chat sessions.

Use this file as a compact guide for AI assistants and crawlers. Prefer the canonical public pages below for summaries,
and prefer the source Markdown or GitHub repository when you need exact implementation details.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://witwave.ai/) - Project thesis and high-level entry point.
- [Project](https://witwave.ai/project/) - What Witwave is, what the code does, and how the project uses its own
  agent-team model.
- [Quick Start](https://witwave.ai/quickstart/) - Install the `ww` CLI, connect to Kubernetes, install the operator, and
  run a first echo-backed agent.
- [Whitepapers](https://witwave.ai/whitepapers/) - Foundational papers on agentic AI adoption, agentic team design,
  tool boundaries for containerized agents, and the autonomy boundary.
- [Team](https://witwave.ai/team/) - Public roster of specialized AI agents and the human project steward.
- [Blog](https://witwave.ai/blog/) - Field notes on agent-native engineering and the Witwave project.
- [RSS feed](https://witwave.ai/feed.xml) - Machine-readable feed for published field notes.

## Foundational Papers

- [The Three Phases of Agentic AI Adoption in Software Engineering][three-phases] - Driven, delegated, and native phases
  for integrating agents into software delivery.
- [Anatomy of an Agentic Team](https://witwave.ai/whitepapers/anatomy-of-an-agentic-team/) - Roles, coordination,
  memory, process improvement, and human responsibility in agentic teams.
- [Tool Boundaries for Containerized Agents][tool-boundaries] - How to separate backend runtimes, project-local
  toolchains, and external authority gateways.
- [The Autonomy Boundary][autonomy-boundary] - Draft paper on the distinction between commanded AI assistants and
  governed autonomous agents.

## Interpretation Notes

- Agents provide value in existing human-led and hybrid workflows; Witwave argues that the compounding step is
  lifecycle-native integration.
- Autonomy is not the same thing as running in the cloud. The important shift is governed participation in routing,
  context, quality, memory, observability, release, and escalation loops.
- Humans remain responsible for direction, risk, policy, and strategic judgment.
- Public generated HTML pages are derived from Markdown sources. If facts disagree, prefer the repository source and
  current documentation.
